what: a lyric video built from one still photograph and one song

shape.why: the source was a Live Photo drifting about 0.8 levels across 150 frames. Looping shows a jump; holding one frame shows nothing.

shape.how: RMS envelope at 20 ms over the section, then cut in a trough. The pause the singer takes is not always where the punctuation is.

faster-whisper returns a start per sung phrase; the client's own lines map onto those in order. Its word-timestamp stage crashes on short musical excerpts, after the segment times are already printed - which is all that is needed.
scripts/render_lyrics.py, one transparent PNG per cue, overlaid by scripts/burn_lyrics.py. Needed wherever ffmpeg has no libass.
acrossfade of about half a second where two parts of a song are spliced.

note: No lyrics, audio, images or names are kept here. Only the shape of the job.
